sahneler.metin: Off Sicily at night, the cruiser Belknap collided with the carrier John F. Kennedy.
Fire engulfed the cruiser, and eight sailors were killed.
Seven died on Belknap and one on the carrier.
The superstructure collapsed in the fire.
The Navy moved back toward steel.

aciklama:
USS Belknap collided with a carrier and burned. The cause: fuel fire weakening an aluminum superstructure until it collapsed.

#shorts #engineering #materials
